items.title: Open-source schema tooling focused on consistency for AI consumers
items.raw_excerpt: I built a small set of open-source schema packages after repeatedly seeing production ecommerce sites where JSON-LD technically existed, but product identity and attributes drifted enough to confuse AI systems. Most “AEO” tooling focuses on monitoring outcomes. This work focuses on the integrity of the underlying product data itself: stable identity, consistency across pages, and explicit handling of conflicting or stale fields. These packages started as internal tooling while building RankLabs, but I pulled them out into standalone, open-source libraries so developers can inspect and reason about the implementation. items.title: Portfolio Terminal – AI import for broker exports

- Parse: paste text / upload CSV, JSON, Excel, or screenshot
- Verify: review and edit extracted rows before sync
- Apply: import in snapshot (replace) or additive (merge) mode I focused on trust and conversion:
- confidence-based parsing output
- explicit review before write
- clear import mode behavior Would love feedback on:
1) parser trust UX
2) default import mode
3) what blocks you from trying this with real data Built with Next.js + Prisma + Postgres. Try it: https://portfolio-terminal.com/onboarding?utm_source=hn&utm_...

items.title: TypeScript 之父 Anders Hejlsberg：别折腾“AI新语言”了，真正变天是 IDE 让位给 Agent
items.raw_excerpt: 过去十年，TypeScript 被很多团队当作“工程化 JavaScript”的答案；到了 AI 编程时代，它又意外变成了 AI 最顺手的语言之一——原因很简单：AI 写代码的能力基本取决于它见过多少这种语言的代码，而 TypeScript/JavaScript 恰好是训练语料最丰富的那一档；更关键的是，TypeScript 还把类型与接口这些“语义线索”明明白白写在代码里，正好让 AI 更容易理解、重构和补全。

title_i18n.zh: TypeScript 之父 Anders Hejlsberg：别折腾“AI新语言”了，真正变天是 IDE 让位给 Agent
title_i18n.en: Anders Hejlsberg, creator of TypeScript: Stop fussing over "new AI languages"; the real game-changer is IDEs giving way to Agents.
title_i18n.es: El padre de TypeScript, Anders Hejlsberg: Dejen de experimentar con "nuevos lenguajes de IA", el verdadero cambio es que el IDE ceda su lugar al Agente.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 过去十年，TypeScript 被很多团队当作“工程化 JavaScript”的答案；到了 AI 编程时代，它又意外变成了 AI 最顺手的语言之一——原因很简单：AI 写代码的能力基本取决于它见过多少这种语言的代码，而 TypeScript/JavaScript 恰好是训练语料最丰富的那一档；更关键的是，TypeScript 还把类型与接口这些“语义线索”明明白白写在代码里，正好让 AI 更容易理解、重构和补全。
excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past decade, TypeScript has been adopted by many teams as the solution for "engineering JavaScript." In the era of AI programming, it has unexpectedly become one of the most convenient languages for AI. The reason is simple: AI's coding ability largely depends on how much code in that language it has been exposed to, and TypeScript/JavaScript happens to be among the most abundant in training data. More importantly, TypeScript explicitly includes semantic cues like types and interfaces in the code, making it easier for AI to understand, refactor, and complete.
excerpt_i18n.es: En la última década, TypeScript ha sido considerado por muchos equipos como la respuesta a la "ingenierización de JavaScript"; en la era de la programación con IA, sorprendentemente se ha convertido en uno de los lenguajes más manejables para la IA. La razón es simple: la capacidad de la IA para escribir código depende básicamente de cuánto código en ese lenguaje haya visto, y TypeScript/JavaScript resulta ser uno de los que tiene el corpus de entrenamiento más abundante. Lo más crucial es que TypeScript incluye explícitamente en el código "pistas semánticas" como tipos e interfaces, lo que facilita que la IA comprenda, refactorice y complete el código.
